coverage.note: Audit scoped to tooltip-relevant surfaces only. Non-interactive or non-tooltip surfaces intentionally skipped.

frontend.title: DoomBar: no tooltips on doom stage label or progress bar
frontend.description: The doom bar shows a stage name and progress percentage but has no hover tooltip explaining what doom stages mean or current threshold values.

frontend.title: MandateTracker: no tooltips on mandate stage pips or progress bar
frontend.description: Mandate tracker shows stage pips and a progress bar but no tooltips on individual stages or the overall mandate concept.

frontend.title: WorldPulse: no tooltips on tick counter, agent count, or mood summary
frontend.description: WorldPulse widget shows aggregate stats but no tooltips explaining what each metric represents.

frontend.title: NarrativeLog: no tooltips on event type color labels or timestamp
frontend.description: Narrative log entries have color-coded type markers but no tooltip explaining what each type means.

frontend.title: ActionDrawer: no tooltips on filter tabs or action category headers
frontend.description: Action drawer shows category groupings but no tooltip explaining what each category covers.

frontend.title: ActionCard: no tooltips on cost pips, detection risk, or range indicator
frontend.description: Action cards display cost, risk, and range as compact visual indicators but offer no tooltip breakdown.

frontend.title: InterventionConfirm: no tooltips on cost breakdown, detection risk, or essence requirement
frontend.description: Confirmation modal shows intervention parameters but no tooltips explaining the mechanics.

frontend.title: AgendaPicker: no tooltips on agenda template items
frontend.description: Each agenda option in the picker modal should have a tooltip explaining its effects.

frontend.title: ScryOverlay: no tooltips on court positions, divine slots, or title proposals
frontend.description: Scry overlay shows divine court but positions lack tooltip explanation.

frontend.title: HarvestScreen: no tooltips on harvest type, echoes, or cycle-end summary
frontend.description: Harvest screen shows cycle results but no tooltips on harvest mechanics.

frontend.title: HexMap: no tooltips on fog-of-war state indicators, avatar marker, or location overlay icons
frontend.description: Map tiles have fog states and overlay icons with no tooltip. Avatar position marker also lacks tooltip.

frontend.title: LocationView: agent tooltips present but location encounter status lacks tooltip
frontend.description: LocationView wraps agents with agent.* tooltips but encounter UI elements have no tooltips.

frontend.title: EncounterLog: no tooltips on threat color badge, progress steps, or active/completed status
frontend.description: Encounter log displays threat levels and progress but offers no tooltip explanation.

frontend.title: HexBreadcrumb: terrain and sphere tooltips present but sight-level indicator lacks tooltip
frontend.description: Breadcrumb wraps terrain and sphere references but the sight level display has no tooltip.

frontend.title: SimulationControls: speed slider lacks tooltip explaining speed multiplier values
frontend.description: Speed slider has no tooltip showing current speed value or explaining the range.

frontend.title: AvatarHUD: tooltip id mismatch — code uses ui.avatar_actions but content defines ui.avatar_wheel
frontend.description: AvatarHUD.tsx passes id='ui.avatar_actions' but ui-content.ts defines the entry as 'ui.avatar_wheel'. Tooltip resolves to null.
frontend.suggestedFix: Rename ui-content.ts entry from ui.avatar_wheel to ui.avatar_actions, or update AvatarHUD to use ui.avatar_wheel.

content.title: Author ~35 new ui.* tooltip entries in ui-content.ts
content.description: The tooltip resolver's ui.* prefix routes to getUITooltip() which reads from ui-content.ts. Currently 11 entries exist. The frontend audit identified ~35 additional tooltip IDs needed across 13 components. Each entry needs a label (short, bold) and desc (1-2 sentences explaining the game concept).
